title: Clusters
description: Connect Kubernetes clusters, check them and see their nodes and namespaces.

disabled.title: Kubernetes clusters are off
disabled.description: Turn on the runtime setting k8s.clusters_enabled to connect clusters.

empty.description: No clusters connected yet. Add one below.

privateApiBlocked: Private and loopback API addresses are blocked. Allow them with the runtime setting k8s.allow_private_api if this cluster is on your own network.
adminWarning: This credential is cluster admin. Prefer a namespace-scoped service account.

connect.title: Connect a cluster
connect.name: Name
connect.nameTaken: A cluster with this name exists.
connect.caHint: PEM. Leave empty when the API server certificate is publicly trusted.
connect.kubeconfigHint: Pasted once and stored encrypted. Exec and auth-provider entries are refused.
connect.allowClusterAdminWarning: Weakens security: this credential can do anything in the cluster. Prefer a namespaced Role from levelrail clusters rbac. It only works while the runtime setting k8s.allow_cluster_admin is on.

disconnect.title: Disconnect {{name}}?
disconnect.description: The stored credentials are deleted. Workloads on the cluster are not touched. Type the cluster name to confirm.

deploy.title: Deploy an app
deploy.envHint: Write only. Values are never shown again.
deploy.allowRootWarning: Only for images that need root. Others run as non-root.
deploy.pageDescription: Deploy a public image to this cluster and watch its status.
deploy.pullSecretMismatch: The image is on {{image}} but {{name}} is for {{secret}}.
deploy.pullSecretNoneStored: No pull secrets stored. Add one in Pull secrets below.

logs.title: Logs for {{name}}
logs.description: Recent log lines from a pod of this app.
logs.truncated: Output was cut at the size limit.

remove.title: Remove {{name}}?
remove.description: Deletes the Deployment, Service and Ingress that Levelrail created for this app. Objects it did not create are left alone.

pullSecrets.title: Pull secrets
pullSecrets.hint: Registry credentials for private images. Write only, never shown again.
pullSecrets.name: Name
pullSecrets.deleteDescription: Running apps keep their copy. New deploys that use this secret will fail. Type the name to confirm.
